rules.label: Full-screen "Listen free in app" screen on phones

meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: TuneIn landing page: app interstitial, Download App link, tile artwork, hero, footer
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA) on tunein.com only; selectors were run on the saved live DOM. Station, podcast and player pages were not loaded, and playback was not tried, so nothing about the web player is covered.

Phone: the page is a full-screen app interstitial ("LISTEN FREE IN APP", data-testid mwLandingBackground, 1) plus a Branch smart-banner iframe (iframe#branch-banner-iframe, 1) fixed at the top (LIVE). Both are added to the app-banners option. Desktop: a marketing landing page with a header, a rotating headline, scrolling tile columns, tile rows and a footer.

- **Download App link**: a[data-testid=landingHeaderMacDesktopLink] 1 (LIVE).
- **Artwork** (Show/Blur/Hide): parallax tile links 20 and tileLinkOverlay links 28 on desktop (LIVE). Blur is a css rule, Hide a hide rule.
- **Landing columns**: the parallaxScrollContainer module class, 1 on desktop (LIVE). It is a readable CSS-module name with a hash suffix, so the match uses a substring.
- **Footer**: footer[data-testid=footer], 1 on desktop, 0 on mobile (LIVE).

The OneTrust consent root exists but was hidden on load; the generic rule covers it. A role=dialog "Ad Data Opt-Out" exists hidden and was not touched. The video-ad slot #web-media-player-ad-container exists inside the player and was deliberately not hidden, since stalling the ad could stall playback. No login link appears logged out. Not verified: logged-in views, other regions, other languages.
